transitions.label: supplier confirms
transitions.note: Acknowledge Received with a fulfillment date

cards.title: Who moves the order
items: LPS creates the order (Chris in the job's Orders tab, or Rosie) only after the customer confirms
New to Processing: the supplier presses Acknowledge Received and enters a fulfillment date; Rosie can record a confirmation the supplier gave another way
Processing to Order Ready: the supplier or Chris presses Mark as Ready
Moves are forward only: no skipping Processing and no going back

cards.title: Set separately from the stage
items: Pickup or delivery is chosen only by Chris; the supplier portal cannot change it
The fulfillment date comes from the supplier when confirming; Chris's order form does not set one
Date and notes can still be edited while the order is open

cards.title: How it relates to the job
items: Creating the order moves its job from Quote or Availability to Committed
The job stays Committed through Processing and Order Ready
Won or Lost can be recorded from any open stage, only on Chris's word
Closing the last order also closes the job when every line's quantity is known and fully ordered
